name: ingenium-ui-monorepo
description: Root convenience scripts for running the Ingenium client (Vue/webpack) and server (Express) together in dev mode

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix src/client" "npm run dev --prefix src/server"
scripts.dev:unminified: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev:unminified --prefix src/client" "npm run dev --prefix src/server"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix src/client && npm install --prefix src/server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix src/client && npm test --prefix src/server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix src/client && npm run test:coverage --prefix src/server
